ORDER :

-
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned APP for respondent no.1 and learned counsel for respondent no.2 2.

By this petition, the petitioners pray for quashing of the FIR, being C.R. No.72 of 2018, lodged at Zilla Peth Police Station, Jalgaon, for the offences punishable under Section 376(2)(n), 376(d), 416,
509 read with Section 34 of Indian Penal Code.

Said FIR has been lodged by respondent no.2,
contending that petitioner no.4 gave promise of marriage and sexually exploited her.
3. The concerned police station after investigation of the crime, submitted charge sheet against the petitioners.

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the petitioners and learned counsel for respondent no.2 invite our attention to the joint compromise purshis/affidavit dated 08.03.2024, sworn before the Officer of this Court.
We have perused said affidavit, wherein respondent no.2/informant contended that she was adult at the time of the incident and now, she has decided to resolve the dispute.
Respondent no.2 further contends that she had lodged the FIR by misunderstanding and misrepresentation and she has no grievance against the petitioners.
5. Learned APP strongly opposed the petition.
6. Admittedly, respondent no.2 was major at the time of the incident for which crime is registered.
It is writ large that it was a case of love-affair between petitioner no.4 and respondent no.2.
Now, since respondent no.2/informant has resolved the dispute, no useful purpose would be served if the matter goes for trial.

7. In view of the above, We exercise the powers under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure and allow the Writ Petition in terms of prayer clauses (A), (B) and (B1), subject to costs of Rs.30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand), to be deposited by the 3 61-crwp311.2019 petitioners with the High Court Legal Services Sub-Committee, Aurangabad, within a period of one week.
 [NEERAJ P. DHOTE, J.] [R.G. AVACHAT, J.]
